listing.name: After Burner Climax (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Windows player for After Burner Climax using its own Xbox 360 package.

steps.title: Prepare your original in the upstream folder
steps.instruction: Keep the Windows x64 package files together in a writable folder. Put your own Xbox 360 LIVE package for title 58410A06 beside after_burner_climax.exe. Keep both bundled executables and the matching original variant together.

steps.title: Use the documented Windows prerequisites
steps.instruction: The package README calls for 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Redistributable when its runtime libraries are missing.

steps.title: Complete first-run setup
steps.instruction: Start after_burner_climax.exe in that folder and let the upstream program prepare assets. Keep your original export separately.

steps.title: Let the upstream entry point select the variant
steps.instruction: The tagged source describes separate World 0.0.1.2 and Original 1.0.0.0 default.xex variants. Start after_burner_climax.exe with either supported original. It can hand off to after_burner_climax_world.exe for the World variant. Close the actual game before changing the folder.

steps.title: Preserve the creating folder
steps.instruction: Keep the generated assets, after_burner_climax.toml and any game-created profile, saves or diagnostic files alongside the creating version.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
